\section{By Round}
The rounds a loop is actually made of. Drill one column at a time.
\subsection*{Breadth (63 questions)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Ch.~1} \quad L5 \quad What is TF-IDF? Derive the formula. When would you use it over neural embeddings?
\item \textbf{Ch.~1} \quad L5 \quad Explain BM25. Why is it still used in production search systems?
\item \textbf{Ch.~1} \quad L5 \quad What is the difference between stemming and lemmatization? When does the choice matter?
\item \textbf{Ch.~1} \quad L5 \quad What is the BIO tagging scheme? Why not just classify each token independently?
\item \textbf{Ch.~1} \quad L5 \quad Explain the difference between rule-based, statistical, and neural NLP. When would you still use rule-based methods?
\item \textbf{Ch.~1} \quad L5 \quad What problems does the bag-of-words assumption create? How have subsequent methods addressed them?
\item \textbf{Ch.~1} \quad L5 \quad Why is context modeling crucial in NLP? Give examples where lack of context leads to failures
\item \textbf{Ch.~1} \quad L5 \quad When would you choose Naive Bayes over a fine-tuned BERT for text classification? Justify your answer
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L5 \quad Why use a CRF layer on top of BERT for NER instead of just a softmax classifier?
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L5 \quad Compare generative and discriminative sequence models. Why are CRFs generally preferred over HMMs for sequence labeling?
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L5 \quad Explain LDA's generative process. What are the latent variables and how is inference performed?
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L5 \quad How do n-gram language models relate to modern neural language models? What did each generation preserve and what did it change?
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L5 \quad Explain the noisy channel model for machine translation. Why was it eventually replaced by neural MT?
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L5 \quad You are building a named entity recognizer for a new domain (e.g., legal documents) with only 500 labeled sentences. Walk me through your approach
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L5 \quad What are the differences between Word2Vec, GloVe, and FastText? When would you choose each one?
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L5 \quad Why are contextual embeddings better than static embeddings? Give a concrete example of when static embeddings fail
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L5 \quad How would you evaluate the quality of word or sentence embeddings?
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L5 \quad What is the distributional hypothesis and why is it foundational to all word embedding methods?
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L5 \quad How does FastText handle out-of-vocabulary words? Why is this an improvement over Word2Vec?
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L6 \quad Explain SimCSE. How does using dropout as data augmentation create meaningful positive pairs for contrastive learning?
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L5 \quad Walk me through the LSTM cell gate by gate. What is each gate's purpose?
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L5 \quad Why did transformers replace LSTMs? What specific limitations did they address?
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L5 \quad Explain the attention mechanism in seq2seq. Why was it needed?
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L5 \quad What is teacher forcing? What problems can it cause?
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L6 \quad Compare additive (Bahdanau) and multiplicative (Luong) attention. When would you prefer each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L5 \quad What are the key differences between LSTM and GRU? When would you choose one over the other?
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L5 \quad A candidate proposes using a bidirectional LSTM for a text generation task. What is wrong with this proposal?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L5 \quad Why do we need multiple attention heads? What happens with just one head?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L5 \quad Compare encoder-only, decoder-only, and encoder-decoder transformers. Why did decoder-only dominate the LLM era?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L6 \quad Explain RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding). Why is it better than learned absolute positions for long sequences?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L6 \quad What does the FFN layer do in a transformer? Is there evidence it stores factual knowledge?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L5 \quad Explain BERT's pretraining objectives. Why was NSP removed in RoBERTa?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L5 \quad Explain pre-norm vs.\ post-norm in transformers. Why did pre-norm become the standard?
\item \textbf{Ch.~6} \quad L5 \quad What is catastrophic forgetting? How do you mitigate it during fine-tuning?
\item \textbf{Ch.~6} \quad L5 \quad Why is data quality more important than data quantity for SFT?
\item \textbf{Ch.~6} \quad L6 \quad Explain ELECTRA's pre-training approach. Why is it more efficient than MLM?
\item \textbf{Ch.~6} \quad L5 \quad What is the difference between feature extraction and fine-tuning? When would you use each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L5 \quad Explain scaling laws for LLMs. What does the Chinchilla paper tell us about compute-optimal training?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L5 \quad Why does chain-of-thought prompting improve reasoning? What are its limitations?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L6 \quad Explain in-context learning. Why can models learn from examples in the prompt without gradient updates?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L6 \quad How do Mixture-of-Experts models work? What is the load balancing problem?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L6 \quad Explain test-time compute scaling (o1-style reasoning). How does it differ from simply making a bigger model?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L6 \quad What are the key factors that affect in-context learning performance? Why do even random labels partially work?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L5 \quad How does an LLM actually call a tool? Walk me through the full round trip from tool definition to final answer
\item \textbf{Ch.~8} \quad L5 \quad Walk me through the RLHF pipeline step by step. What are the three stages?
\item \textbf{Ch.~8} \quad L5 \quad What is reward hacking? How does the KL penalty help? When does it fail?
\item \textbf{Ch.~8} \quad L6 \quad What is Constitutional AI? How does self-critique enable alignment without human feedback at every step?
\item \textbf{Ch.~8} \quad L6 \quad What is the difference between process and outcome reward models? When would you use each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~9} \quad L6 \quad What is HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings)? When would it help and when would it fail?
\item \textbf{Ch.~9} \quad L5 \quad Explain the bi-encoder vs.\ cross-encoder tradeoff in retrieval. How would you use both in a production system?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L5 \quad What are the problems with LLM-as-judge evaluation? When would you use it and when would you not?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L5 \quad Explain ROUGE. How is it different from BLEU?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L5 \quad Compare greedy decoding, beam search, and nucleus sampling. When would you use each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L6 \quad How do you handle benchmark contamination? How would you design an evaluation pipeline that is robust to it?
\item \textbf{Ch.~11} \quad L5 \quad How would you handle aspect-based sentiment analysis at scale?
\item \textbf{Ch.~11} \quad L6 \quad How would you detect sarcasm in text? Why is this hard?
\item \textbf{Ch.~11} \quad L5 \quad When is an LLM overkill for an NLP task? Give concrete examples
\item \textbf{Ch.~12} \quad L5 \quad Explain the KV-cache. Why is it necessary for autoregressive generation? How much memory does it use?
\item \textbf{Ch.~12} \quad L6 \quad What is speculative decoding? Why does it produce the same distribution as standard autoregressive decoding?
\item \textbf{Ch.~12} \quad L5 \quad Explain BPE tokenization. How is it trained? How does it handle OOV words?
\item \textbf{Ch.~13} \quad L5 \quad How do you measure and reduce bias in an NLP system? Walk me through your approach for a resume screening application
\item \textbf{Ch.~13} \quad L5 \quad What ethical considerations arise when deploying LLMs at scale? How do you address them in practice?
\item \textbf{Ch.~13} \quad L6 \quad How does text watermarking for LLMs work? What are the tradeoffs?
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{Depth (36 questions)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L5 \quad Explain the Viterbi algorithm. What is its time complexity? Trace through a small example
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L5 \quad What is perplexity? How does it relate to cross-entropy? What are its limitations as an evaluation metric?
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L6 \quad Explain Kneser-Ney smoothing. Why is it better than add-1 (Laplace) smoothing?
\item \textbf{Ch.~2} \quad L6 \quad What is the partition function in a CRF? Why is it computationally challenging, and how is it computed efficiently?
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L5 \quad Explain the Word2Vec Skip-gram model. What is the training objective? What is negative sampling and why is it needed?
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L6 \quad Explain the connection between Word2Vec, GloVe, and matrix factorization on co-occurrence statistics. Why does this connection matter?
\item \textbf{Ch.~3} \quad L6 \quad Your new embedding model wins offline---$+4$ points Recall@100 on your evaluation set---but loses the online A/B test. Walk me through your investigation
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L5 \quad Explain the vanishing gradient problem in RNNs. Why does LSTM solve it? Walk through the math
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L6 \quad When would you still use an LSTM over a transformer?
\item \textbf{Ch.~4} \quad L5 \quad Explain Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT). How is it different from standard backpropagation?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L5 \quad Explain self-attention step by step, including the math
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L5 \quad Why do we scale by $\sqrt{d_k}$? Derive the variance argument
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L5 \quad What is the computational complexity of self-attention? Why is it a problem?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L6 \quad Compare Multi-Query Attention, Grouped-Query Attention, and standard Multi-Head Attention. When would you use each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~5} \quad L5 \quad You need to build a production NLP system that classifies customer support tickets into 50 categories. Would you use BERT or GPT-4? Justify your choice
\item \textbf{Ch.~6} \quad L5 \quad When would you use LoRA vs.\ full fine-tuning? When would LoRA fail?
\item \textbf{Ch.~6} \quad L6 \quad Compare the major pre-training objectives: MLM, CLM, span corruption, and ELECTRA. When would you choose each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L6 \quad When would you choose Mamba (or an SSM) over a Transformer?
\item \textbf{Ch.~7} \quad L5 \quad Compare few-shot prompting, fine-tuning, and RAG for adapting an LLM to a new task or domain. When would you use each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~8} \quad L6 \quad Explain DPO. How does it relate to RLHF? What are its advantages and limitations?
\item \textbf{Ch.~8} \quad L6 \quad Compare RLHF, DPO, and KTO. When would you use each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~8} \quad L7 \quad Derive the DPO loss from the RLHF objective
\item \textbf{Ch.~9} \quad L5 \quad Compare BM25 vs.\ dense retrieval. When would you use each? When would you combine them?
\item \textbf{Ch.~9} \quad L5 \quad How would you evaluate a RAG system end-to-end? What metrics would you track?
\item \textbf{Ch.~9} \quad L5 \quad When should you use RAG vs.\ fine-tuning vs.\ long context?
\item \textbf{Ch.~9} \quad L6 \quad Your RAG system is returning correct documents but the LLM's answers are still wrong. What would you investigate?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L5 \quad What is BLEU? Derive it step by step. What are its limitations?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L5 \quad What is perplexity? How does it relate to cross-entropy? What are its limitations?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L6 \quad You are building a code generation system. BLEU is commonly reported for code generation---is it a good metric? What alternatives would you propose?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L6 \quad A model achieves state-of-the-art on MMLU but users report it gives poor answers in practice. What could explain this gap?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L6 \quad Your model gained 6 points on the internal benchmark suite, but users can't tell the difference---what happened?
\item \textbf{Ch.~11} \quad L5 \quad Compare extractive vs.\ abstractive summarization. What are the tradeoffs and when would you use each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~11} \quad L5 \quad Compare Naive Bayes vs.\ fine-tuned BERT for text classification. When might Naive Bayes win?
\item \textbf{Ch.~12} \quad L6 \quad Compare GPTQ, AWQ, and INT8 quantization. When would you use each?
\item \textbf{Ch.~12} \quad L5 \quad When would you choose knowledge distillation over quantization or pruning to compress a model?
\item \textbf{Ch.~13} \quad L6 \quad How do you handle the tradeoff between helpfulness and safety in an LLM system? Give concrete examples

\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L5 \quad How would you evaluate a summarization system? Specifically, how would you measure faithfulness?
\item \textbf{Ch.~10} \quad L6 \quad Design an evaluation pipeline for a production chatbot that handles customer support for an e-commerce company

\item \textbf{Ch.~11} \quad L6 \quad You need to build an information extraction system that populates a knowledge graph from news articles. Walk through your approach
\item \textbf{Ch.~12} \quad L6 \quad How would you serve an LLM at 10K QPS with less than 500ms time-to-first-token?
